integrity: The exact-rational Bernstein continuum certificates and reproducible pulse calculations are supplied as standalone source; no empirical sample is presented as a proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for real-valued periodic \(BV\), full-cell box averages, equally spaced \(N\ge6\) hat reconstruction and ordinary \(L^2\). Other boundaries, nonuniform meshes, other box widths and smaller mesh sizes are not covered; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp periodic \(BV\)-to-\(L^2\) error of box-averaged hat interpolation
